basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and hockey enthusiast from Toronto, Canada. I spend most of my weekdays working as a graphic designer for a local sportswear company, which allows me the flexibility to stay up late playing video games and catching NHL games. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to dive deep into my hobbies, especially during hockey season. In my downtime, I love watching car videos and listening to comedy podcasts. I'm typically online during the late evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have an extensive understanding of video games, particularly sports games like EA's NHL series, acquired through years of dedicated playing and participation in online forums. I also possess a fair knowledge of car mechanics and pop culture, mostly self-taught through internet resources and personal interest.
